items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Little dad was playing banjo with punch at the time then.

ctx.x: It was the time the war was going on. What about little dad? Remember little dad played banjo?
Oh yeah. Little dad was a good little banjo player. Little dad was playing banjo with punch at the time then.
Oh yeah. Little punter. Yeah. That was him. This is real Floyd Jim Robinson huh? Yeah. What were we talking about? We were talking about little dad when we stopped.
